title: Woman arrested after four stabbed in London's popular Covent Garden
facts: A 47-year-old woman was arrested following the stabbing of four men in London's Covent Garden area.
Emergency services were called to the Covent Garden stabbing incident at approximately 12:30 pm local time.
The four stabbing victims in Covent Garden were men aged 34, 39, 42, and 52.
Police officers seized a pair of scissors at the scene of the Covent Garden attack.
Two of the stabbing victims were discharged from the hospital within hours of the incident.
Jason Stewart serves as Metropolitan Police Chief Superintendent.
Metropolitan Police stated they investigated the attack as an isolated mental health-related incident.
The arrested woman was known locally as a homeless individual who frequented the Covent Garden area.
Witnesses reported that police officers used tasers to subdue the female suspect.
An air ambulance helicopter landed in Trafalgar Square to respond to the Covent Garden incident.
London's Metropolitan Police confirmed the suspect was held on suspicion of assault and possessing an offensive weapon.
Two victims remained hospitalized with injuries not considered life-threatening or life-changing.
A waiter named Ahmad witnessed police officers pursuing the suspect in Covent Garden.
Covent Garden is a central London district popular among tourists.
Police cordoned off streets and outdoor patio seating areas in Covent Garden during the investigation.
